sources.title: On almost commuting matrices with respect to the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm
sources.interface: Fixed pairs or fixed finite tuples of selfadjoint contractions in M_d with normalized trace.
sources.scope: Dimension independent for a fixed pair/tuple; constants and exponent depend on tuple size beyond pairs.
sources.mismatch: No uniform growing-tuple result, CP-map preservation, or EB map theorem.

sources.title: A Note on Approximate Liftings
sources.interface: Theorem 4.2: fixed finite n-tuples in tracial C*-algebras. Theorem 4.4: trace-preserving *-homomorphisms from countably generated abelian von Neumann subalgebras into ultraproducts of diffuse finite von Neumann algebras.
sources.mismatch: Fixed n does not give uniformity in growing CP range rank; Theorem 4.4 is a *-homomorphism lift with diffuse coordinates, not a UCP channel/EB lift for finite matrix coordinates.

sources.title: Tracial Stability for C*-Algebras
items_checked: Abstract and Sections 1-2 tracial stability definitions
sources.interface: Stability/lifting of homomorphisms from fixed separable C*-algebras and fixed relations in tracial norms.
sources.mismatch: No channel-map norm or EB approximation result for a full growing CP image.

sources.title: On ultrapowers of non commutative L_p spaces
sources.interface: Ultrapower identification for Haagerup L_p spaces.
sources.mismatch: No CP-map lifting or EB rounding theorem.
